slot-e8e48890-f913-4b0d-bad2-4c8da2a2a7e.quote_span: audio and video streams of Parton’s discography skyrocketed 2,458% on the day of her death, compared to Monday — climbing from 1.2 million to 30.5 million in the U.S.
slot-e8e48890-f913-4b0d-bad2-4c8da2a2a7e.speaker: Luminate

slot-7a3c38ea-398c-4761-b37c-f89a27855f9.quote_span: And by Wednesday, that number rose to 46.3 million.
slot-7a3c38ea-398c-4761-b37c-f89a27855f9.speaker: Luminate

slot-2d416eee-f5ad-4ff6-8952-696404aa2e1.quote_span: Worldwide, her audio and video streams jumped 1,549%, from 2.5 million on Monday to 41.8 million Tuesday.
slot-2d416eee-f5ad-4ff6-8952-696404aa2e1.speaker: Luminate

slot-ba29f222-7a71-4cf1-a556-f2e1008feba.quote_span: 1. “Jolene” grew from over 196.2K streams on Monday to 3.3 million Tuesday and 4 million Wednesday.
slot-ba29f222-7a71-4cf1-a556-f2e1008feba.speaker: Luminate

slot-6e6e8b65-21ed-4cb8-9bf1-033cce3523e.quote_span: 2. “9 to 5” jumped from 208.6K on Monday to 3.0 million on Tuesday and 3.6 million on Wednesday.
slot-6e6e8b65-21ed-4cb8-9bf1-033cce3523e.speaker: Luminate

slot-ec4639f0-2d36-4fc5-b9b5-a014ddf700a.quote_span: 3. “Islands in the Stream,” her duet with the late Kenny Rogers, climbed from 165.9K on Monday to 2.1 million Tuesday and 2.9 million Wednesday.
slot-ec4639f0-2d36-4fc5-b9b5-a014ddf700a.speaker: Luminate

slot-8732f42e-64d8-46b4-b7bd-e3f5543581a.quote_span: 4. “I Will Always Love You,” Parton’s performance of her own classic, a song that was later made famous by Whitney Houston’s rendition, rose from 64.9K streams on Monday to 2.0 million Tuesday and 2.8 million Wednesday.
slot-8732f42e-64d8-46b4-b7bd-e3f5543581a.speaker: Luminate

slot-c552f23f-1703-496b-9405-2f48e4e8e1d.quote_span: 5. “Here You Come Again” followed, moving from 48.7K streams Monday to 1.5 million Tuesday to 2.1 million Wednesday.
slot-c552f23f-1703-496b-9405-2f48e4e8e1d.speaker: Luminate

slot-2b2bcedd-e486-4a11-b3f9-f14c73bf3ac.quote_span: 6. Then there was “Coat of Many Colors,” with 28.9K streams Monday to 1.3 million Tuesday and 1.9 million Wednesday.
slot-2b2bcedd-e486-4a11-b3f9-f14c73bf3ac.speaker: Luminate

slot-46b2e7cd-7c52-4f48-86ac-be990904388.quote_span: 7. “Why’d You Come In Here Lookin’ Like That?” climbed from 22.1K Monday to 827K Tuesday and 1.3 million Wednesday.
slot-46b2e7cd-7c52-4f48-86ac-be990904388.speaker: Luminate

slot-26c80fb8-2f51-4b00-8ab5-9e1bb9d0d2d.quote_span: 8. “There Was Jesus,” her 2019 duet with Christian singer Zach Williams, rose from 85.2K streams Monday to 635.1K Tuesday and 682.0K Wednesday.
slot-26c80fb8-2f51-4b00-8ab5-9e1bb9d0d2d.speaker: Luminate

slot-f055d2ca-cde4-4f70-92c4-2f2cfa90e3e.quote_span: 10. “Tyrant,” Parton’s collaboration with Beyoncé from Bey’s Grammy winning 2024 album “Cowboy Carter,” jumped from 47.8K Monday to 559.2K Tuesday and 755.5K Wednesday.
slot-f055d2ca-cde4-4f70-92c4-2f2cfa90e3e.speaker: Luminate

slot-72f1613f-89a9-4103-8c76-fcde4b5b1a3.quote_span: As of early Friday afternoon, three Parton books were in the top 5 on Amazon.com ’s bestseller list.
